links.outcome: Temporal drift in predictive model performance across pandemic waves for ICU, IMV, and death
links.effect: Recall for the positive class fell from wave 1 to wave 3: ICU 0.4211 to 0.1951; IMV 0.2089 to 0.0438; death 0.2711 to 0.1175.
links.quote: Temporal drifts were observed due to a decrease in various metrics, such as the recall for the positive class [ICU: 0.4211 (wave 1) to 0.1951 (wave 3); IMV: 0.2089 (wave 1) to 0.0438 (wave 3); death: 0.2711 (wave 1) to 0.1175 (wave 3)].

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter cohort study analyzing temporal data drift and feature importance across COVID-19 pandemic waves using LightGBM and SHAP, but not evaluating an active intervention or deployment practice.
